draft.title: Representations of concepts over time
card: A concept is a big idea, such as heroism, family or success. Texts show it in a particular way. That way is a representation.
Representations change across time and cultures, because people in different times and places value different things.
For example, an old tale might show a hero as a lone warrior who wins by strength. A recent film might show a hero as an ordinary person who helps others and shares the credit.
Comparing how texts represent the same concept shows each text's context: the time, place and values it was made in.
draft.remember: The same concept can be shown in different ways, and the differences point to each text's context.

a.q: What does it mean to say a text represents a concept such as family?
opts: It shows the idea in a particular way
It gives a dictionary meaning of the word
It proves the one true form of the idea
It names every family in the text
a.why: A representation is the particular way a text shows a concept. The dictionary option is wrong because a text shows an idea through its characters and events, and different texts can show it differently.
a.clue: Think of how a text chooses to show an idea.

b.q: A story from the 1800s shows a successful person as someone who earns great wealth and a grand house. A story written this year shows success as having good friends and time for hobbies. What does the difference best suggest?
opts: The two stories come from contexts with different values
One author understands success and the other does not
Success has no meaning in either story
The newer story must be the better text
b.why: Each story represents success in a way that matches what its time and culture valued, so the difference points to context. The tempting option says one author is wrong, but the card shows that representations differ because values differ, not because of skill or knowledge.
b.clue: Ask what each time and place valued.

a.best: It shows the idea in a particular way

b.best: The two stories come from contexts with different values
